issues.detail: Spec does not fix whether start_shifting asserts on the detecting posedge (row 5) or one cycle later (row 6); contract chooses same-cycle and marks R_DETECT uncertain.
issues.spec_evidence: When the sequence is found, it should set start_shifting to 1, forever, until reset.
issues.alternative: start_shifting asserts one clock after the posedge that samples the final 1 of 1101
